title: Here's when Samsung plans to release its Android XR glasses and where
description: Earlier this month, a report out of South Korea claimed that Samsung's Intelligent Eyewear would launch in November, citing "a Samsung official". Today, a new report from the same country tells us when you'll actually be able to buy the glasses: in mid-December. That's not the whole story, though, as they're said to only go on sale in South Korea and the US at first, with Europe, China, and Japan left out of the initial release. Apparently, Samsung wants to see how the Korean and US markets react before expanding to more regions, which is pretty much what it did with its Galaxy XR headset....

title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro vs. iPhone 18 Pro Max
description: It's time for an upgrade, and you are eyeing the new iPhone 18 Pro series. But which one to get? The smaller iPhone 18 Pro or the larger iPhone 18 Pro Max? Sometimes it's not just about screen size; it's also about features and performance. The Pro Max has historically been better at endurance and has offered one or two exclusive features. So what else is the 18 Pro Max's price premium buying you except a larger screen size? Let's dive in and find out. description: Which chipset the Galaxy S27 Ultra will use has turned into quite the saga over the past few months. Back in July, the Ultra was said to be getting a Snapdragon chip globally, while the rest of the lineup would use the Exynos 2700 outside of North America. Then in early September, insiders claimed that Samsung was building Exynos 2700-powered S27 Ultras for Korea and Europe. title: A new vulnerability can brick your Android phone when receiving the SMS of Death
description: Security researcher Mark Blaszczyk found a new scary vulnerability that affects phones running Android 12 or later. It involves receiving a specially crafted WAP Push SMS message that Android's telephony framework cannot properly process. The tricky part is that instead of displaying the message in the inbox, Android tries to process it in the background. This triggers an error that can cause all sorts of issues. Active phone calls start to disconnect, the device temporarily loses cellular service, and when receiving multiple messages like this, the device can even become unusable....

title: Oppo Reno17 series confirmed to launch next month, blind pre-orders go live
description: Oppo’s upcoming Reno17 series has been the subject of several leaks and rumors over the past few weeks. While a recent rumor pointed to a launch next month, Oppo has now officially confirmed the timeline. In a post on Weibo, Oppo's official account confirmed that the Reno17 series will launch in China next month, although the company has yet to announce an exact date. Interested buyers can already visit Oppo's online store to pre-reserve the upcoming smartphones. Alongside the Reno17 series, Oppo will also introduce its new Watch 5 smartwatch and Pad Air 6 tablet. title: The new iPad mini's battery capacity is no longer a mystery
description: Apple unveiled the iPad mini (2026) on Monday with an OLED screen and the A20 Pro chipset, and while it told us the battery is rated at 18.9Wh, it didn't give its capacity in mAh, in typical Apple fashion. Today, that's finally been revealed thanks to the tablet's listing in the EU's EPREL database. According to the listing for model number A3596, the new iPad mini has a rated battery capacity of 4,900 mAh. That's a bit smaller than the 5,078 mAh (19.3Wh) cell in the iPad mini (2024), which isn't exactly surprising given that the new model is almost 1mm thinner and close to 40g...

title: Samsung is reportedly working on a huge foldable tablet
description: Back in late August, a tipster on X claimed that a 17-inch foldable tablet is in development, with multiple versions and test devices being worked on, but didn't say which company is making it. Now, the same tipster has followed up with a short but telling addition, revealing that "Samsung has already started." According to the original post, the device becomes an 8-inch tablet when folded and expands to 17 inches when unfolded. That's all we've got for now, as the tipster says they can't share any more details yet. How exactly the 8-inch folded state would work is anyone's guess at...

title: Oppo Reno17 F 5G gets NBTC certified
description: Oppo has confirmed it will unveil the Reno17 series in China next month, but it hasn't officially said when it will launch internationally. While we await more information on the Reno17 series' global debut, Thailand's NBTC has certified the Reno17 F 5G, bringing it a step closer to launch. The NBTC listing for the Reno17 F 5G includes its model code, CPH3013, but it doesn't reveal anything else. title: Strava subscribers can now connect directly to Google Gemini for personalized workout insights
description: Back in June, Strava launched the Model Context Protocol (MCP) connector, letting subscribers query their Strava data through Claude for in-depth training insights. Building on that launch, Strava has announced a Google Gemini integration that lets subscribers get more from their training. Strava subscribers who connect directly to Google Gemini will now get more contextual and personalized answers based on their activity history. Once connected, Gemini can analyze Strava users' data and tell them whether they are getting faster at the same heart rate, how strength training is affecting...

title: Omdia: global smartphone shipments declined 20 percent YoY in Q3 2026
description: According to a new report by research firm Omdia, global smartphone shipments declined 20 percent year-on-year in the third quarter of 2026. Manufacturers shipped a total of 254.7 million units during the quarter. The report noted that this was the lowest third-quarter shipment volume since 2013, attributing the decline to rising smartphone prices. Samsung retained its position as the world's largest smartphone maker, shipping 57.8 million units, however, it was down 5 percent year-on-year. Apple followed closely with 56.5 million iPhones shipped, keeping its shipment numbers...

title: Gemini now lets you edit the files it creates right in the chat
description: Back in April, Google's Gemini gained the ability to generate files for you, from Docs and Sheets to PDFs and Markdown. Until now, though, if you wanted to tweak what it came up with, you had to download or export the file first. Today, Google is fixing that by letting you preview and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, code, and more right in the Gemini app. Files can be expanded to full screen, where you can type your edits directly, highlight text to ask questions about it, have Gemini refine the text or visuals, or ask it follow-up questions. description: Last week, a rumour claimed that vivo was preparing to launch the S70 in China with a 64MP Sony periscope telephoto camera and support for a teleconverter. title: The Nokia 2360 Flip is a dual-display feature phone with an SOS button
description: HMD has unveiled the Nokia 2360 Flip, its latest feature phone with a clamshell design and the Family Assist feature. Designed with school students and senior citizens in mind, the phone features dual displays and a dedicated SOS button. The Nokia 2360 Flip's main highlight is its Family Assist feature, which allows family members to remotely manage the device. They can add contacts, adjust volume levels, set reminders, and access other settings remotely. It also features a dedicated SOS button on the rear panel. Pressing it calls a pre-set emergency contact and sends an alert...

title: The new OLED iPad mini runs Geekbench, here are the results
description: Apple unveiled the iPad mini (2026) with an OLED screen and the A20 Pro chipset on Monday, and the first units will reach buyers on November 6. Ahead of that, one has already been run through Geekbench 7, so we now have a good idea of how it performs. The CPU has five cores (two performance and three efficiency ones), with the performance cores clocked at 4.93GHz. description: Motorola first showed off the Signature 27 during Qualcomm's Snapdragon Summit back in September, but it's been holding back the full specs and pricing ever since. Yesterday, its Indian website said the phone is "coming this November", and now the company has narrowed that down to an exact date: November 5. Here's what we already know. The Signature 27 is powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, cooled by an ArcticMesh system with a vapor chamber that's 40% larger than the previous generation's. description: The Oppo Find X10 Ultra's full camera setup leaked earlier this week, but what about the chip that will be powering it? The Find X9 Ultra launched back in April with the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset, so you'd expect its successor to stick with Qualcomm. That might not necessarily be the case. description: The iPhone Air 2 is expected to launch alongside the iPhone 18 and iPhone 18e next spring. title: T-Mobile CEO rules out letting SpaceX's Starlink Mobile run on its network
description: SpaceX has made no secret of its plans to enter the US telecom market, and earlier this month it bought more spectrum to turn Starlink Mobile into a full-fledged carrier. It's also reportedly in talks to get access to at least 80,000 cell sites across the country. A quicker way to get started would be an MVNO deal with an existing carrier - basically, renting capacity on someone else's network. Now, T-Mobile CEO Srini Gopalan has made it clear that this won't be happening with his company.
